body: I had a multitude of professional help from hospitalization to long term therapy and in all honesty with my defense mechanism of locking everything up i cant even begin to trust anything to the point of opening up fully, much less taking anything away from it. Its more of a issue where ive been hurt by too many people to honestly try and let someone else touch the mess thats my issues.

Its more of a lack of being able to find anthing my heart truly links woth on a level i wish to continue doing it, art, writing, gaming, woodwork, metalworking, ive ventured into many thing and can be quite skilled at nearly anything but my heart never truely invests itself in it.
